title: Chemiresistive gas sensors for intelligent sensing: design strategies, emerging applications and future challenges
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00979K, Review Article
Chencheng Hu, Wei Zhang, Jiaqi Yang, Yuehan Pei, Xiaoyi Tan, Biao Dong, Hongwei Song, Lin Xu
This review highlights recent advances in intelligent chemiresistive gas sensing platforms, covering material innovations, AI integration, applications, and challenges, and outlining future directions toward responsive sensing ecosystems.
